claims.claim_text: The resumed diagnostic completed successfully without changing original model weights or old artifacts.

Frozen internal representations contain decodable operational motion-change risk in this exploratory scene-family readout test, but this does not prove independent native generalization or beneficial utilization.
Raw-versus-encoded, social-stage, and context-stage effects depend on reader, scene, and metric; feature dimensions and native training exposure are alternative explanations.
Change-risk classification is distinct from event type, coarse timing, signed direction, and accurate whole-path generation.
Clear-change cases have both poorer same-path coverage and native-selection misses; nearly static cases are much easier under the operational thresholds.
Native input masks and fixed small functional perturbations characterize routing/dependence, not causal quality improvement or verified in-distribution interventions.
The next discussion should review blind past-only judgments and distinguish event-conditioned generation versus ranking errors; no new training is authorized by this report.

negative_constraints: Only three scene families; no reliable group CI, Holm or formal permutation p
